description: CBU Service Center - Electricity is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Monthly electricity usage, peak demand, and cost data at the CBU Service Center. Electricity usage reflects all on-site usage, including that from solar PV panel generation. Cost data is the monthly bill received from Duke, which includes the credits received from on-site solar PV electricity generation. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Utilities & Water. The table has 8 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
